cards.front: No podemos seguir peleándonos todo el tiempo. Tenemos que resolver las cosas.
cards.back: We can't keep arguing all the time. We need to work it out.

cards.front: Se llevan mucho mejor ahora, desde que han resuelto sus problemas.
cards.back: They get on much better now since they've worked out their issues.

cards.front: Busquemos una solución al problema.
cards.back: Let's work out a solution to the problem.

cards.front: Ella lo ha planeado todo. Primero van a Westminster, después al South Bank y después al Museo Británico.
cards.back: She's got it all worked out. First they're going to Westminster, then they're going to the South Bank, and then they're going to the British Museum.

cards.front: Lo planeó todo. ¡Será fantástico!
cards.back: He worked out the entire plan. It'll be fabulous!

cards.front: ¡Sólo tiene veinte y pocos años, pero ya ha planeado toda su vida!
cards.back: She's only in her early twenties but she's already got her whole life worked out!

cards.front: ¡Odio las matemáticas! Nunca sé calcular la solución.
cards.back: I hate maths! I can never work out the answer.

cards.front: Ella nunca puede calcular sus impuestos.
cards.back: She can never work out her taxes.

cards.front: Él no podrá calcularlo mentalmente. Necesitará una calculadora.
cards.back: He won't be able to work it out in his head. He'll need a calculator.

cards.front: ¡No llores, por favor! Al final todo saldrá bien.
cards.back: Please don't cry! It'll all work out in the end!

cards.front: Se preocupa por todo, pero las cosas siempre salen para mejor.
cards.back: She's such a worrier, but things always work out for the best.

cards.front: No salió bien después de todo.
cards.back: It didn't work out after all.

cards.front: Cuando no entiendes el significado de una palabra, sueles descifrarla por el contexto.
cards.back: When you don't understand the meaning of a word, you can usually work it out from the context.

cards.front: Nadie entiende lo que pasó.
cards.back: Nobody can work out what happened.

cards.front: Lo encuentro un poco raro. La verdad es que no consigo entenderlo.
cards.back: I find him a bit strange. I really can't work him out.

cards.front: No te pongas así, no merece la pena.
cards.back: Don't get so worked up, it's not worth it.

cards.front: No puedo evitar alterarme cada vez que hablo con él, ¡es tan engreído!
cards.back: I can't help getting worked up every time I speak to him, he's so full of himself!

cards.front: Ella se altera si mencionas a su jefe anterior, así que yo no lo haría.
cards.back: She gets worked up if you mention her previous employer, so I wouldn't.

cards.front: Es curioso que siempre te alteres por las cosas más extrañas.
cards.back: It's funny how you always get worked up about the strangest things.

cards.front: ¿De verdad se puso así él por lo que dije? ¡Sólo estaba bromeando!
cards.back: Did he really get worked up about what I said? I was only joking!

cards.front: Calma, ¿vale? No hay por qué ponerse así.
cards.back: Relax, ok? There's nothing to get worked up about.

cards.front: ¿No se alteró mucho ella cuando se enteró de que él había quedado con su ex para cenar?
cards.back: Didn't she get all worked up when she heard he'd met his ex for dinner?

cards.front: No sé lo que me dio. ¡Me alteré completamente sin razón aparente!
cards.back: I don't know what got into me. I got all worked up for no apparent reason!

cards.front: Nosotros podemos criticar a nuestra familia, pero nos alteramos mucho si lo hace otra persona.
cards.back: It's alright for us to criticize our family, but we get all worked up if somebody else does.

cards.front: No es buen momento, él está completamente alterado.
cards.back: It's not a good time right now, he's all worked up.

cards.front: ¿Por qué está tan alterado?
cards.back: What's he so worked up about?

cards.front: Creo que está tan alterado por el nuevo abollón en su coche.
cards.back: I think he's so worked up about the new dent in his car.

cards.front: Intentad mantener la calma, ¿queréis? Alteraros no ayudará.
cards.back: Try and keep your cool, will you? Working yourselves up won't help.

cards.front: Es increíble cómo se pone él siempre que pierde al ajedrez.
cards.back: It's incredible how he works himself up whenever he loses at chess.

cards.front: Ellos se alteran tan fácilmente que es mejor que no les digamos lo del retraso.
cards.back: They work themselves up so easily, we're better off not telling them about the delay.

cards.front: Charles, tienes que ponerte con tus deberes, o si no luego no podrás salir.
cards.back: Charles, you need to get on with your homework, or you're not going out later.

cards.front: Charles, ¿has recogido ya tu cuarto? Pues ponte con ello ahora mismo.
cards.back: Charles, have you tidied your room yet? Well, get on with it right away!

cards.front: ¡Charles, tienes que ponerte con tu trabajo ya mismo! ¡No has hecho más que vaguear por la casa!
cards.back: Charles you really need to get on with your work! You've been doing nothing but lazing around the house!

cards.front: Charles, limpia el salón y, ya que estás, tráeme la revista.
cards.back: Charles, clean the living room and while you're at it, bring me my magazine!

cards.front: Charles, lava los platos y, ya que estás, pasa la fregona.
cards.back: Charles, do the washing up and while you're at it, mop the floor!

cards.front: Charles, recoge la cocina y, ya que estás, prepárame un té.
cards.back: Charles, tidy the kitchen and while you're at it, make me a tea!

cards.front: Estamos trabajando con el objetivo de un futuro mejor para todos.
cards.back: We're working towards a brighter future for everyone.

cards.front: Estamos trabajando con el objetivo de tener un medio ambiente más limpio y seguro.
cards.back: We're working towards a cleaner and safer environment.

cards.front: Estamos trabajando con el objetivo de tener una mayor conciencia de reciclaje.
cards.back: We're working towards an improved awareness on recycling.

cards.front: Trabajamos día y noche para que tú no tengas que hacerlo.
cards.back: We work around the clock so you don't have to.

cards.front: Trabajamos día y noche para darte el servicio que necesitas.
cards.back: We work around the clock to provide you with the service you need.

cards.front: Trabajaremos día y noche si es necesario.
cards.back: We'll work around the clock if necessary.

cards.front: Vale, la reunión ha terminado. ¡Pongámonos manos a la obra!
cards.back: Right, the meeting's over; let's get down to business.

cards.front: ¡Bueno, ya es hora de ponernos manos a la obra! ¡Vamos!
cards.back: It's time to get down to business guys! Now come on!

cards.front: ¡Dejemos de tocarnos las narices y pongámonos manos a la obra!
cards.back: Let's stop messing around and get down to business.

cards.front: Terminé la carrera de Filología Hispánica con matrícula.
cards.back: I graduated with honors in Spanish.

cards.front: Estudié Económicas.
cards.back: I did Economics at uni.

cards.front: Me formé como cocinero en una de las mejores escuelas técnicas.
cards.back: I trained as a chef at one of the best technical schools.

cards.front: Me contrataron de secretaria, pero en realidad trabajaba de chica para todo.
cards.back: I was hired as a personal assistant but I actually worked as a girl Friday.

cards.front: Me contrataron en mi primer trabajo mientras aún estaba en la universidad.
cards.back: I was taken on at my first job while I was still in college.

cards.front: Me uní a la campaña del senador Smiths justo después de terminar la carrera.
cards.back: I joined Senator Smiths' campaign just after I graduated.

cards.front: Nunca me han despedido de ninguno de mis trabajos. Siempre los he dejado antes de que me pudieran echar.
cards.back: I've never been laid off from any of my jobs. I've always quit before I could be made redundant.

cards.front: Echaron a media empresa después de la fusión.
cards.back: Half the company was made redundant after the merger.

cards.front: ¡Mi despido no fue procedente! ¡Fue un despido improcedente!
cards.back: I wasn't fired! I was laid off!

cards.front: Me abrí camino en la empresa haciéndome notar y apreciar.
cards.back: I climbed the ladder by getting myself noticed and appreciated.

cards.front: Ascendí trabajando duro y siendo humilde.
cards.back: I worked my way up by working hard and keeping my head down.

cards.front: Me reclutó una agencia de cazatalentos.
cards.back: I was head-hunted by an external agency.

cards.front: Dimití cuando me di cuenta de que ya no podía aprender nada nuevo.
cards.back: I resigned when I realized I couldn't learn anything new anymore.

cards.front: La universidad me obligó a jubilarme del puesto de profesor pero sigo intentando publicar en las revistas profesionales.
cards.back: The university forced me to retire from teaching but I still try to publish in the professional journals.

cards.front: Decidí darle a la medicina un descanso así que colgué el estetoscopio y la bata blanca durante un tiempo.
cards.back: I decided to take a break from medicine so I hung up my stethoscope and white robe for a while.

cards.front: Estoy encantada con lo que ha hecho Lisa. Trabajaba como una burra en ese proyecto.
cards.back: I'm delighted with what Lisa's done. She worked her socks off on that project.

cards.front: Trabajaron como unos burros en esa propuesta. Apenas me puedo creer que no la eligieran.
cards.back: They worked their socks off on that proposal. I can hardly believe it wasn't chosen.

cards.front: Trabajé como un burro en ese libro, ¡pero valió la pena!
cards.back: I worked my socks off on that book but it has totally paid off!

cards.front: Ella trabajó mucho para proporcionar un buen hogar a su familia.
cards.back: She worked her fingers to the bone to provide a good home for her family.

cards.front: Trabajaron mucho para llegar donde están ahora.
cards.back: They worked their fingers to the bone to get to where they are today.

cards.front: Trabajé mucho para aprobar esos exámenes.
cards.back: I worked my fingers to the bone to pass those exams.

cards.front: Estoy encantada con lo que ha hecho ella. Tenía un gran desafío con ese proyecto.
cards.back: I'm delighted with what she's done. She had her work cut out for her on that project.

cards.front: Tenían un gran desafío frente a ellos con esa propuesta. No me sorprende que no la escogieran.
cards.back: They had their work cut out for them on that proposal. I'm not surprised it wasn't chosen.

cards.front: Tenía un gran reto con ese libro, ¡pero valió la pena!
cards.back: I had my work cut out for me on that book, but it has totally paid off!

cards.front: Trabajaba de sol a sol para proporcionar un buen hogar a su familia.
cards.back: She worked from dawn to dusk to provide a good home for her family.

cards.front: Trabajaron de sol a sol para llegar donde están hoy.
cards.back: They worked from dawn to dusk to get to where they are today.

cards.front: Trabajé de sol a sol para aprobar esos exámenes.
cards.back: I worked from dawn to dusk to pass those exams.

cards.front: Los decoradores hicieron maravillas con mi piso nuevo.
cards.back: The decorators worked miracles on my new flat.

cards.front: Ha hecho maravillas con su pronunciación; ahora habla como un nativo.
cards.back: He's worked miracles on his pronunciation; he speaks like a native now.

cards.front: La florista hizo maravillas con las flores de la iglesia.
cards.back: The florist worked miracles on the flowers in the church.

cards.front: ¿Puedes hacer este párrafo como sólo tú sabes? Es que no consigo hacer que suene bien.
cards.back: Can you work your magic on this paragraph? I can't get it to sound right.

cards.front: Dwaine Rooknee jugó como sólo él sabe en el campo anoche y marcó tres tantos.
cards.back: Dwaine Rooknee worked his magic on the pitch last night and scored a hat-trick.

cards.front: Déjame hacerlo como sólo yo sé hacerlo; va a necesitar un toque femenino.
cards.back: Let me work my magic on this; it's going to need a woman's touch.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no usas esta receta para tu cita de mañana? Funcionará de maravilla.
cards.back: Why don't you try this recipe for your date tomorrow? It'll work like a charm.

cards.front: Si le compras unos bombones, funcionará de maravilla.
cards.back: If you buy her some chocolate, it'll work like a charm.

cards.front: Si te echas esta colonia, funcionará de maravilla.
cards.back: If you wear this aftershave, it'll work like a treat.

cards.front: Trabajó como un burro en el guion y, al final, no lo usaron.
cards.back: He worked himself to death on the script and in the end they didn't use it.

cards.front: Estoy trabajando como un burro en este informe, pero no llego a ningún sitio.
cards.back: I'm working myself to death on this report at the moment, but I'm not getting anywhere.

cards.front: Si les asignas el proyecto, lo trabajarán como burros.
cards.back: If you assign the project to them, they'll work themselves to death on it.

cards.front: Si yo fuera tú, evitaría a Mark de ventas. ¡Es un pájaro de cuidado!
cards.back: If I were you I'd avoid Mark from sales: he's a nasty piece of work!

cards.front: Él es un pájaro de cuidado cuando está borracho.
cards.back: He's a nasty piece of work when he's drunk.

cards.front: ¡Menuda pájara! ¡Es tan falsa!
cards.back: What a nasty piece of work she is! She's so two faced!
